about: R1 CONCEPTS (PLAN-P §4.2) A-bar grades of the D1 'Burrow Works' drafts against art-direction.md §1.3 R1-R8 and §7.4 (A = same finish as our pink boss at game size, 3 px/pt, next to char_sci_home@3x.png). Drafts: dest route3d, nothing shipped. Graded by LOOKING at every sheet in this folder.
